description:
You are an IT manager at Acme Corp. Corporate branding guidelines have been updated and you need to configure the email signature for the 'IT Support' mailbox in FreeScout.

Log into FreeScout (admin@helpdesk.local / Admin123!) and navigate to the settings for the 'IT Support' mailbox. Update the email signature to contain the following standardized company footer:

Best regards,
Acme Corp IT Support Team

Hours: Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST
Phone: (555) 234-5678
Email: itsupport@acmecorp.com
Portal: https://support.acmecorp.com

CONFIDENTIALITY NOTICE: This email and any attachments are for the exclusive and confidential use of the intended recipient. If you are not the intended recipient, please do not read, distribute, or take action based on this message.

Make sure to save the settings after entering the signature. The signature should contain ALL of the above elements: team name, hours, phone number, email, portal URL, and the confidentiality notice.
